Ward Round - 06/03/2020, 02:36 (overnight medical review, day 1 of admission)

Background: Admitted to hospital at 20:22 on 05/03/2020 with confirmed COVID-19
pneumonia (SARS-CoV-2 PCR positive, reported 18:46 on 05/03/2020) and hypoxemia
(SpO2 <92% on air at 11:53 on 05/03/2020).

Observations: Temperature 37.9°C, HR 108 bpm, RR 24/min, SpO2 94% on 2L nasal cannula,
BP 122/72 mmHg. NEWS2 5.

Bloods: CRP 132 mg/L, Lymphopenia noted, renal function normal, D-dimer elevated at 1.8
mg/L.

VTE prophylaxis: Enoxaparin first dose given 22:25 on 05/03/2020, tolerated well, no bleeding
concerns. To continue once daily.

Escalation status: For full escalation including ITU if required given young age and reversible
pathology; ceiling of care discussed and agreed as appropriate for critical care referral if
deteriorates.

Plan: Continue supplemental oxygen, aim SpO2 >94%. Repeat bloods and chest X-ray in the
morning. Continue enoxaparin od. Monitor NEWS2 hourly overnight given borderline score.
Encourage oral fluids and paracetamol for fever.

Escalate to the medical registrar if RR >30 or increasing oxygen requirement. Encourage oral
fluids and paracetamol for fever.
